analysis.reasonEn:
Previous 3 sessions maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI continues to trade in neutral territory, and ADX at 14.3 indicates no trend formation. MACD histogram is worsening, but the 5-day low pattern signals a recovery.
Volume at 0.35x average shows sluggish movement. With ATR at $8.67, a 1.3x stop loss ($11.27) and 2.6x target ($22.54) would result in a risk-reward ratio below 1.5.
Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach in the current range.
